govinfo.get_returns: JSON {message} with no results array — sketch GET probe was a miss
govinfo.ranking: Noisy. collection:(USCOURTS) "765 F.3d 999" returned 234 hits whose first page was unrelated E.D. Wash. cases. Name-match required before found=True.
govinfo.not_for_unbound_scotus: USCOURTS does not host Medical Marijuana v. Horn. Slip PDF https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/24pdf/23-365_6k47.pdf is the authoritative source.

ca9_cdn.strip_no_prefix: CourtListener docketNumber is often 'No. 13-35356'; CDN file is 13-35356.pdf. 'No. 13-35356.pdf' 404s.

non_case_law_excluded: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov (statutes — used for Pen. Code § 3008 verbatim)
OAL / CDCR rulemaking pages (regulations — OAL Matter 2025-0321-01C pinned 15 CCR § 3574 effective date)
CDCR Form 3043 (agency form, not publicly openable as standalone)
scope: Case-law citation verification sources isolated from the Matter 28 primary-source verification prompt (2026-09-19). Rule 2 of the prompt gives the preference order; 'proven_in_run' marks sources a verification worker actually read successfully during the 2026-09-19 run.

sources.name: CourtListener
sources.coverage: Federal + state opinions; citation-lookup and full-text search APIs
sources.provenance: Opinions search used for Wicklund v. Idaho (zero results — confirmed unreported)
sources.wire_notes: Already probed by lookup-citations.py (citation lookup + search). No change needed.

sources.name: Caselaw Access Project (static.case.law)
sources.coverage: Reporter PDFs for published state/federal cases (citation-addressable)
sources.provenance: Pollock 112 Cal.App.4th 1416 and Sain v. Wood 512 F.3d 886 read from reporter PDFs
sources.wire_notes: Already probed by lookup-citations.py (lookup_cap). No change needed.

sources.name: Justia (law.justia.com + docs.justia.com)
sources.coverage: Federal/state opinions (HTML) + federal docket PDFs via docs.justia.com
sources.provenance: Wicklund memo, Valvo 67 Cal.App.3d 887 read in full; Merrill S.D. Cal. orders via docs.justia.com
sources.wire_notes: Already probed by lookup-citations.py (probe_justia). Usually Cloudflare 403 in this environment.

sources.name: govinfo.gov (GPO)
sources.coverage: Federal opinions incl. USCOURTS collection; official API with key
sources.provenance: 2026-09-19 live POST confirmed field names; ranking too noisy to treat first hit as the pin. Not the Horn source.
sources.wire_notes: Probe exists behind --probe-extra. POST JSON. Name-match required. Do not use for unbound U.S. Reports.

sources.name: Ninth Circuit opinions (cdn.ca9.uscourts.gov)
sources.provenance: ASARCO 13-35356 and Esche 24-6244 PDFs 200; Wicklund memo under /memoranda/; Lee/Palomar-era CDN 404.
sources.wire_notes: Probe exists behind --probe-extra. Strip 'No. ' from CL docketNumber. Try opinions then memoranda. Pre-~2010 published opinions often missing.

sources.name: California Courts opinions (courts.ca.gov)
sources.coverage: Cal. Supreme Court + Courts of Appeal opinions (PDF)
sources.provenance: Meinhardt (2024) 16 Cal.5th 643 read in full from .../opinions/documents/S274147.PDF
sources.wire_notes: URL pattern .../documents/<DOCKET>.PDF (e.g. S274147.PDF). Docket-addressable; needs docket-number lookup step. Still unwired.

sources.name: U.S. Supreme Court (supremecourt.gov)
sources.coverage: Slip opinions + bound-volume PDFs; authoritative for unbound U.S. Reports cites
sources.wire_notes: No public API. Filename is docket-hash, not citation-addressable. Highest remaining unwired source for unbound U.S. cites.

sources.name: Cornell LII — Supreme Court
sources.wire_notes: URL pattern /supremecourt/text/<volume>/<page> (e.g. /521/399 for Richardson). Citation-addressable with no lookup step. Will not have unbound slips.

sources.name: scocal.stanford.edu (Cal. Supreme Court)
sources.coverage: Cal. Supreme Court opinions, full HTML text
sources.wire_notes: Slug-addressable HTML. Needs cite-to-slug resolution; useful fallback when CAP lags (Cal. 2d is not in REPORTER_MAP).

sources.name: FindLaw Caselaw
sources.wire_notes: No API; HTML scraping only. Lowest priority — duplicates CAP/CourtListener coverage.

sources.name: alldocket.com
sources.provenance: Estate of Esche (9th Cir. Sept. 29, 2025) read in full from alldocket PDF path
sources.wire_notes: Opaque IDs; not systematically addressable. Manual fallback only — do not build a probe around it.

wiring_recommendation.note: The four already-wired sources cover published pins. New probes add value only where CAP/CL miss: recent CA9 CDN PDFs, district USCOURTS packages, and SCOTUS slips.
priority_order: ca9_cdn (filename confirmed; opt-in probe now fetches opinions + memoranda)
supremecourt_gov slip opinions (only authoritative source for unbound U.S. cites such as Horn)
govinfo POST + name-match (official API, but ranking is not a citator)
courts_ca_gov + scocal (Cal. direct PDFs / Cal. 2d fallback)
